intro: A unit publishes an agent —a prompt, a folder of documents and the group of people who may use it— and the organisation's general assistant runs it. Publishing it is registering it: it is offered straight away, and a reviewer can suspend it afterwards.
ninguno: Your organisation has not published any agent yet.
fallo: It could not be saved. Try again.

pistas.carpeta_url: The folder's address in the organisation's storage. The platform keeps no documents: the storage authorises them.
pistas.grupos: Comma separated, as the identity provider declares them.
pistas.revision_prevista_en: When the unit will look at it again. If it passes, the agent is still offered, but flagged.
pistas.presupuesto_documentos: How many documents a query may return at most, between 1 and 10. They are the URLs the general assistant will open at once.
pistas.hoja_del_indice: CSV or Excel with one row per document. Required columns: url, titulo and resumen; optional: vigente, revision_prevista_en and prioritario. Write the column names exactly as shown, untranslated; any other column is kept as metadata. The sheet is the whole index: whatever is missing is withdrawn.
pistas.adjunto: If the person consulting attaches their own document in the assistant, the folder's documents are the criteria to analyse it. “May attach” lets them say so in each consultation.
pistas.lengua_respuesta: The platform adds the instruction to the prompt: no need to write it. Tender specifications always in Spanish; resolutions always in Valencian.
pistas.datos_consulta: What is essential for the documents to be chosen well: in a tender agent, the contract type and the CPV. If the index has a column with that detail, write it and it will filter: documents contradicting it are dropped, those not stating it are kept.
pistas.indicaciones: A line the person asking will see, in the extension and in “Consult”. For example: “Give the contract type and the CPV; if you attach a draft, say what it is about”.
pistas.reservas: Places in each query reserved, at least, for a layer of the index (column «capa»): law or case law do not compete with hundreds of examples. The closest to the question within each layer is chosen; what a layer does not fill goes back to the general allocation.

aviso_sin_grupos: No identity provider groups are arriving right now: only institutional SAML sign-in sends them. An agent limited to some groups would be offered to nobody.

errores.carpeta_https: It has to be an https address in the organisation's storage.
errores.fecha_obligatoria: Say when it will be reviewed again.
errores.opciones_minimas: A list needs at least two options.
errores.reservas_suman: Reserved places cannot add up to more than the documents per query.
errores.reservas_repetidas: Each layer is reserved only once.
errores.capa_sin_letras: The layer must contain letters or numbers.

consulta.intro: Choose an agent, write your question and copy the prompt that is prepared: it carries the links to the relevant documents. Paste it into the organisation's general assistant, which will open them with your account. The platform records that you asked and which documents were offered; if the agent is in validation, it also keeps your question and the answer, to check that it works well.
consulta.ninguno: There is no agent for you yet.
consulta.fallo: The prompt could not be prepared. Try again.
consulta.como_usarlo: Copy it and paste it into the general assistant. If the assistant cannot open a document, it will say so instead of answering from memory.
consulta.copiado: Copied. Paste it into the organisation's general assistant.
consulta.no_copiado: It could not be copied. The prompt is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C.
consulta.describe_el_adjunto: Describe in your question the document you will attach (for example, "review a tender for a minor services contract"): it is what lets the right regulations be chosen.
consulta.adjunta_el_documento: When you paste the prompt into the assistant, attach your document in the same message.
consulta.se_guarda_la_conversacion: This agent is in validation: your question and the assistant's answer are kept to check it works well.
consulta.que_falta: What is missing or what do you want to narrow down?
consulta.que_falta_ayuda: Other documents are searched with this text and the details above, without repeating the ones you already have. You can change the details.
consulta.misma_conversacion: Paste it into the same assistant conversation, not a new one.
consulta.no_quedan: There are no more relevant documents for this in the agent's index.

indice_sin_actualizar: The script has not sent the index in recent days
faltan_documentos_one: {{count}} document of the folder is missing from the index ({{carpeta}} in the folder)
faltan_documentos_other: {{count}} documents of the folder are missing from the index ({{carpeta}} in the folder)
fichas_desfasadas_one: {{count}} entry summarised with an earlier prompt
fichas_desfasadas_other: {{count}} entries summarised with an earlier prompt

actualizacion.intro: An Apps Script installed next to the folder goes through the documents every morning, summarises the new or changed ones with Gemini and sends the index. It runs with the unit's account: the documents never leave Google.
actualizacion.paso_hoja: Create a spreadsheet next to the folder and, from it, open Extensions › Apps Script. Preferably in a shared drive: a script in a personal account is lost when that person leaves.
actualizacion.paso_guion: Paste the script and its manifest (the button below shows them).
actualizacion.paso_propiedades: In the script properties, set the agent identifier, the platform address, the token, the folder, the sheet and the Google Cloud project. The script's header explains it.
actualizacion.paso_diario: Run actualizarIndice once to authorise it, and then instalarActualizacionDiaria.
actualizacion.tokens_intro: It only sends the index of the agents you maintain: it cannot publish, withdraw or issue other tokens. Anyone who can edit the script will see it, so revoke it when no longer used.
actualizacion.emitir: Issue a token for the script
actualizacion.solo_una_vez: Copy it now into the script properties: it will not be shown again.

propuesta.descripcion: Describe what you want the agent for
propuesta.pista: In your own words: what it should do, for whom and what not. The name, unit, purpose and whether it expects an attachment are taken into account. The proposal replaces whatever is in the prompt field.
propuesta.aviso: Proposal by {{modelo}}. Review and edit it before publishing: the version will say it was drafted with AI help.

extension.intro: With the extension, the agents sit in a panel next to the assistant: pick one, type the question and the current prompt is copied. Here you see where it is connected and disconnect it for real; disconnecting from the extension only forgets it in that browser.
extension.ninguna: The extension is not connected in any browser.
extension.conectar_texto: The extension will be able to see the agents offered to you and prepare their prompts with your account. It cannot publish, change or see anything else. The connection expires in 30 days and you can revoke it from “Consult”.
extension.no_es_control: The extension is a convenience: the assistant can be used without it just the same.

integracion.intro: The extension inserts the prompt into the assistant and reads the answer with these selectors. When the assistant changes its page, extensions report which selector stopped working and it is fixed here: each change is a new version all of them pick up without updating.
integracion.como_corregir: Check the selector on the assistant page before saving it. Then add the capture of the new page to extension/instantaneas and update extension/adaptadores in the repository, so the tests watch it.
integracion.rota_one: Broken: one report, for selector “{{selector}}” on {{fecha}}
integracion.rota_other: Broken: {{count}} reports, the last for selector “{{selector}}” on {{fecha}}

registro.validacion: In validation: every question is kept with its answer
registro.incidencias: Incidents only: what is reported as inadequate is kept

dato.prefijo: Matches by the start (codes like the CPV)

calidad.contadores: Queries: {{consultas}} · answers read: {{leidas}} · reports to review: {{informes}}

pistas.indice: the folder or the index summary
pistas.seleccion: the document budget or the query details

sin_captura.sin_respuesta: It was not sent, or no answer came.
sin_captura.sin_terminar: The answer did not finish in time.
sin_captura.selector: It could not be read: the assistant integration failed.
sin_captura.copiado: It was copied to paste by hand: the extension cannot read the answer.
